3.name: Divination Savant
3.description: Choose two Wizard spells from the Divination school, each of level 2 or lower, and add them to your spellbook for free. Whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one Wizard spell from the Divination school to your spellbook for free.

3.name: Portent
3.description: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, roll two d20s and record the numbers rolled. You can replace any D20 Test made by you or a creature that you can see with one of these foretelling rolls before the roll is made, once per turn. Unused rolls are lost when you finish a Long Rest.

6.name: Expert Divination
6.description: When you cast a Divination spell using a level 2+ spell slot, you regain one expended spell slot of a level lower than the slot you expended and no higher than level 5.

10.name: The Third Eye
10.description: Use a Bonus Action to gain Darkvision, Ethereal Sight, Greater Comprehension, or See Invisibility until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

14.name: Greater Portent
14.description: You roll three d20s for your Portent feature, rather than two.
